title: Repair exact-action receipt pin without rewriting immutable N104C.1 receipt
implementation: pin the repair to the exact current runtime commit
emit a fresh receipt for the repair action itself only if runtime executes that repair action
prove receipt SHA and runtime commit equality
record mismatch as a local gate result when encountered
do not use the repair receipt as evidence for original N104C.1
only after a fresh action-specific receipt exists may a new transport action be opened
completion_gate: fresh repair receipt is immutable, its action_id is BRAIN-N104C.1R.REPAIR, its commit_sha equals exact-current runtime commit, and original N104C.1 receipt remains unchanged; otherwise DENY
